entity_raw.definition_raw:
The roar of the crowd strengthens your resolve.

Prerequisite(s) Endurance.

Benefit(s) When you spend a swift action to attempt a performance combat check, you gain a +2 bonus on your performance combat check, and if you are shaken, sickened, or fatigued, these conditions are suppressed until the end of your next turn.
